_comment: Reference template. Copy to config.json and fill in. config.json IS committed for Renovate 8 (see .gitignore), but keep secrets out if you fork this.

builder.name: Renovate 8
builder.legal_name: <FILL IN — licence-holding entity, e.g. Gold and Eagle Constructions>
builder.trading_as_line: <FILL IN — e.g. Gold and Eagle Constructions trading as Renovate 8>
builder.licence: <FILL IN — NSW Fair Trading Contractor Licence number>

defaults.payment_terms: Payable on issue of next progress claim, or within 14 days of separate invoice, whichever applies.

projects._comment: Keyed by the short project code. variations_path is the subfolder, under the project, where the V# folders live — defaults to dropbox.variations_subfolder. Override it for projects with a non-standard layout (e.g. staged jobs that file variations under 'Variations/Phase 2').

_example_staged.notes: Staged project — file variations under the Phase 2 subfolder only.
